contentHtml:
The process to start a professional career in the United Arab Emirates includes getting a UAE employment visa. Understanding everything related to this document is really important, it does not matter if you are an expatriate or a citizen. This information will help you ensure compliance with the UAE government regulations and will foster a good workforce transition.

In this article, you will comprehend everything related to the employment visa UAE. We will provide you with the essential information you must know in order to demystify and make the process of getting this visa easier. So, let us get started and learn about this visa.

UAE Employment Visa Types

In order to meet the varying demands of its workforce, the UAE offers a variety of employment visa options. Employers and people navigating the immigration procedure must have a thorough understanding of these visa classifications. Therefore, the primary UAE employment visa types include:

  • Entry Employment Visa: This first visa, which is granted to foreign citizens arriving in the United Arab Emirates for work, enables them to lawfully work there.
  • Residence Employment Visa: Moreover, it is typical for someone with an entrance employment visa to change to a residence employment visa once they are in the United Arab Emirates. This visa allows for longer stays and facilitates easier attainment of legal residency.
  • Investor Employment Visa: Furthermore, entrepreneurs and business investors are the target audience for the Investor Employment Visa. Which makes it easier for them to participate in the local business community.

These employment visa UAE categories offer flexibility and legal compliance in the field. By doing this, it meets the various demands of foreign nationals and companies doing business.

Standard Work Visa

The Standard Work Visa, a highly sought-after UAE employment visa, offers a comprehensive set of advantages for foreign nationals looking to pursue career opportunities in Dubai. Here are the key features:

  • Two-Year Duration: Providing an extended period of legal residency in the UAE, promotes stability for employees.
  • Affordable Pricing: With a cost range spanning from AED 3000 to AED 7000, the Standard Work Visa presents an economical option for both employers and individuals.
  • Flexibility in Cost: Furthermore, the 2-year employment visa Dubai price spectrum allows flexibility. This helps enable employers and individuals to choose services that cater to their specific needs.
  • Streamlined Application Process: Moreover, the visa category offers a more straightforward and effective application procedure. As a result, this simplifies the process of recruiting skilled employees.
  • Contribution to Economic environment: The Standard Work Visa is essential to the UAE’s dynamic and varied economic environment. This is because it draws in skilled labor.

Thus, the Standard Work Visa complies with legal criteria and supports the UAE’s objective of developing a workforce that is competent, diversified, and dynamic.

Green Visa

The UAE’s Green Visa, a groundbreaking type of residence visa, introduces a novel approach to sponsorship and residency. Here are the key features of the Green Visa:

  • Self-Sponsorship for 5 Years: Holders have the unique ability to sponsor themselves for an extended period of 5 years.
  • Elimination of Traditional Sponsorship: Unlike conventional visas, the Green Visa removes the necessity for sponsorship from a UAE national or employer.
  • Empowerment and Autonomy: Moreover, individuals holding the Green Visa experience a new level of empowerment. They can enjoy autonomy in managing their residency status.
  • Streamlined Self-Sponsorship Process: The Green Visa simplifies the process of self-sponsorship. It also provides a more straightforward and efficient experience for individuals.
  • Diversity and Inclusivity: Furthermore, this initiative reflects the UAE’s commitment to fostering a diverse and dynamic expatriate community, promoting inclusivity.
  • Enhancing Attractiveness for Professionals and Entrepreneurs: The Green Visa contributes to the UAE’s ongoing efforts to attract qualified professionals and entrepreneurs. Specifically, to further increase the nation’s global appeal.

Golden Visa

The UAE’s Golden Visa stands as an unparalleled long-term residence visa, presenting foreign talents with an array of exclusive benefits. This distinctive visa category not only allows individuals to live, work, or study in the UAE but also offers the following advantages:

  • Six-Month Entry Visa: Provides a six-month entry visa with multiple entries to initiate the residence issuance process.
  • 5 or 10-Year Renewable Visa: Grants a long-term, renewable residence visa, valid for either 5 or 10 years, ensuring extended periods of stay.
  • No Sponsorship Requirement: Eliminates the need for a sponsor, providing individuals with increased autonomy in managing their residency.
  • Extended Stay Flexibility: Enables individuals to stay outside the UAE for more extended periods, surpassing the usual six-month limit to maintain their residence visa validity.
  • Family Sponsorship Privileges: Allows family members, including spouses and children of all ages, to be sponsored for fostering family unity.

UAE Employment Visa Basics

Navigating the basics of a UAE employment visa involves understanding key elements such as cost, duration, and post-cancellation protocols.

    • Cost Range: The total employment visa cost in UAE, inclusive of all taxes and handling fees, typically falls within the range of AED 3000 to AED 7000.
    • How many days I can stay in UAE after employment visa cancellation? As of 2025, individuals have a standard period of 30 days to stay in the country after the cancellation of their UAE employment visa.

Post-Cancellation Procedures: 

  • It is imperative that you finish the process of canceling your residence within the allotted thirty days.
  • In addition, end your lease in accordance with the termination of your visa.
  • During this time, make sure to pay off any unpaid debts.

Application Process for UAE Employment Visa

Here is the UAE employment visa process step by step:

  • Job Offer Acceptance: Firstly, receive and accept a job offer from a UAE employer.
  • Document Submission: Then, submit the required documents to the employer, including educational certificates and passport copies.
  • Employer’s Application: Therefore, the employer initiates the visa application through the relevant authorities.
  • Entry Permit Issuance: Moreover, if your application is approved, you will be provided with an entry permit to the UAE.
  • Medical Examination: Furthermore, undergo a mandatory medical examination in the UAE.
  • Emirates ID and Residency Stamping: Finally, obtain the Emirates ID and complete residency stamping to formalize the UAE employment visa.
